name: Sorairo Memories
source:
Main character is surprised to see a girl next to him as he wakes up. All the neighbors claim that she is protagonist's sister Sora-chan. Girl has no memories prior to standing in front of the house. They decide to walk around the island to try to regain the memory. Is she really protagonist's sister who he has no recollection of?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公醒来时，惊讶地发现身旁躺着一名女孩。所有邻居都坚称她是主人公的妹妹小空。女孩对站在这栋房子门前之前的事情毫无记忆，于是两人决定在岛上四处走走，尝试找回她的记忆。她真的是主人公毫无印象的妹妹吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
